summary: This diff adds a real Playwright E2E test suite (7 spec files, auth setup, helpers, config) plus a detailed findings report for PROJEXA's Finance/Sales/HR modules and the AI Copilot, and bumps package.json/bun.lock with a single devDependency (@playwright/test); it touches no application source under src/**, no schema/migrations, and no .github/workflows files, which matches the deterministic tier1 classification and confirms the hard rule against workflow-file edits was respected. The tests are well-scoped and methodologically sound (real UI assertions via visible text/ARIA rather than fake data-testids, before/after network verification for writes, re-run-safety comments for the several modules lacking delete UI), and the accompanying findings doc is unusually rigorous, citing exact file:line locations for each of the several real product bugs it surfaces (HR/Payroll's ctx.dbUser wall, Wiki's missing organizationId, GRC's request-publish 500, the Copilot's DeleteProject hallucination) rather than asserting them speculatively — these are correctly left as follow-up findings rather than being fixed inline, keeping this PR's blast radius to test/doc additions only. Two things are worth recording for the audit trail rather than blocking merge: the shared plaintext test password in e2e/users.ts (MeridianE2E2026! fallback) repeats a precedent already established and merged in Phase 1 (PR #45) for this synthetic, no-real-customer-data test org, and the ci.yml workflow does not run this suite automatically, so there's no risk of every PR silently hammering the live production site and permanently accumulating rows in it -- only manual/on-demand runs do. Also note: git state shows PR #46 for this exact diff was already merged into main (commit 45a5b2e, mergedAt 2026-07-19T08:36:20Z, tree-identical to this diff's content) before this review ran, with only a PROGRESS.md-only checkpoint commit on top -- this appears to be a retroactive/duplicate audit pass rather than a pre-merge gate, worth checking whether the dispatch pipeline is double-invoking review after an autonomous tier1 merge already completed.
issues: PR #46 (this exact diff) is already merged into origin/main (commit 45a5b2e, mergedAt 2026-07-19T08:36:20Z) -- this review is running after the fact, not as a pre-merge gate; worth confirming the supervisor pipeline isn't double-dispatching audits for already-merged tier1 work.

e2e/users.ts commits a shared plaintext fallback password (MeridianE2E2026!) for the seeded E2E test-org accounts to source control; low real-world risk since it's a synthetic test org with no real customer data and this repeats an already-merged Phase 1 precedent (PR #45), but general secret-hygiene practice would prefer an env-var-only credential with no hardcoded fallback.
This diff does not touch .github/workflows/** -- no hard-rule violation to flag.
